protocol.purpose: Validate two conditional ideas with six direct-control arms, not claim six or ten innovations.
protocol.carrier: Frozen initialized spatialRP64, fixed train-only coordinate statistics; identical identity/free/bounded residual charts at initialization. Report total/frozen/trainable parameters and whether the bound actually activates.
protocol.pathquery: Same auxiliary head and causal rollout; symbols/scalar-completion/full-path transformations, within-clip RGB queries only. No future state or query enters the predictor. CE normalized by log(classcount), globalweight1.
protocol.fairness: Same task split, seeds, original550initialtensors, underlyingTF objective, native50caseCEM/evaluator. Extra parameters and compute matched within each family; different acrossfamilies. Calibration access explicitly recorded.
limitations: 600updates remain inside1249warmup; neither superiority nor permanentfailure follows from one early gate.
Carrier cannot recover information missing from its frozen measurement; spatialcarrier statistics use128trainingframes per task/seed.
Within-clip path queries have known static/query-only shortcuts; complete transform requireshalves to expose allclasses.
Class counts and active output rows differ; equalhead parameters do not imply identical effectivecapacity.

health.scope: Validation-only matched-noise diagnostics. State permutations preserve posterior-noise draws; zero-state sensitivity alone can be a constant-bias effect. Numerical health is not learned control or generation success.

information.scope: Frozen diagnostics only. Small amplitude is not proof of absent information. Off-support scale/anchor interventions are not policy improvements.

access_contract.observed_future: Actual future encoding: tautological zero-error reference, not prediction.

access_contract.teacher_forced_prefix: Each step receives all real past frames through that step; no future frames.

access_contract.initial_carry: Only initial encoding, repeated over the horizon; no dynamics.
access_contract.interventions: Same clean target; global different-episode initial, zero initial, valid-step action-order shift and other-episode actions.
